summary: Lowe Lippmann is a St Kilda Road chartered accounting and advisory firm trusted for over 75 years, recognised in the AFR Top 100 list in November 2025. Partner Danny Lustig, who advises small to medium family businesses on tax compliance and bookkeeping systems, received an Order of Australia Medal in the 2026 Australia Day honours. The firm is audit, insolvency and tax-led, so fit is weak.

first.subject: Reconciliation at Lowe Lippmann
first.body:

Reading your profile, you advise small to medium family businesses on tax compliance and bookkeeping systems, which is where manual reconciliation tends to pile up around lodgment deadlines. I built Vert to turn hours of manual reconciliation into minutes, with a traceable audit trail rather than AI that guesses. How much of your team's time goes on reconciling client ledgers before the tax work can start? Open to a 10 min walkthrough?
